summary: Delegate unhandled Promise rejection tracking to the selected JavaScript host compatibility runtime.

requirements.host: browser, Node.js, or Electron compatibility requested

target.notes: HostPromiseRejectionTracker behavior, notification timing, and late-handler behavior are host-defined.

caveats: Browser unhandledrejection and Node.js unhandledRejection/rejectionHandled behavior are not identical.
Pure .NET unobserved Task exception behavior is not a substitute.

tests.name: late handler host tracking
tests.expected_behavior: selected host profile may report unhandled rejection before the later handler and later report it handled

tests.name: immediate handler
tests.expected_behavior: normally not reported as unhandled by the selected host
